features.description: Clear their whole row and reel when no wins remain.

features.name: xHole
features.description: Re-shuffles the board when nothing else happens.

review:
A gentler Nolimit with medium volatility. When no wins are left, bombs clear their whole row and reel, and xHole sucks symbols off the reels and spits them back out in new spots.

Multiplier Increasers add their value to the next multiplier when they land. A 5,051x max is low for Nolimit, which makes this one of their most approachable modern games. 96.07% RTP.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
